system.notes: SR3 p.275 prints the damage as "(STR - 1)M Stun +7S Stun": the glove's fist damage is (STR - 1)M Stun (the Damage field) and the gloves deliver an extra +7S Stun (the Extra Damage field), which the melee result resists separately, with Impact armour at half (SR3 p.124). Eight discharges, then a 1-hour recharge (p.276) - not tracked.
